name: curbcut-fixtures
consent_note: Every file is synthetic and authored for this repository. No screen capture, screenshot, accessibility string, or personal data is included, so no participant consent is required.

files.role: Canary corpus: distinctive strings that must never appear in a log, dump, crash report, or any other diagnostic.

benchmark.note: The byte count is deterministic for a fixed iteration count; elapsed time is the only varying field.
